fields.FIR_Description: It was alleged that Kumaran Subramani parked a grey motorcycle bearing registration number TN-23-ZZ-1086 at Mangai Puram Railway Station Road and found it missing on return. The matter was brought to Tiruppur North PS on 2025-09-22, while the incident was placed on 2025-09-22 at about 04:55. The complaint was lodged by Bharath Prakash (9000000118) on behalf of Kumaran Subramani, whose contact number is given as 9000000078. The complainant alleged that Murugan Sundaram may be involved and provided the mobile number 9000000207.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Vehicle reportedly taken from an unattended parking area.
fields.Keywords: motorcycle theft, vehicle, suspect, early morning, CCTV, motorcycle, vehicle observation, mobile number
